name: stockwatcher
description: Live stock-market dashboard and heat map in the browser, steered from the chat: indices, sectors, themes, companies, investor 13F portfolios, r/wallstreetbets, and questions about companies researched once and remembered. Learns your portfolio and usual requests. No API keys. By AI Realist.

interface.shortDescription: Live stock dashboard and heat map
interface.longDescription: Ask for an index, a sector, a theme, companies, an investor's 13F portfolio or what r/wallstreetbets is discussing, and a live dashboard with a heat map opens in the browser. It remembers your portfolio, your usual requests and what it has researched, all on your computer. Needs Node.js 18 or newer; no API keys and no accounts. Not investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Show me the S&P 500 heat map
This is my portfolio: 10 AAPL, 5 MSFT, 20 nvidia
